## Checklist
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format required by `release-please`.
- [ ] Code adheres to Go conventions (`gofmt -s`, `go vet`).

- [ ] Zero-Trust security invariants preserved (E2EE AES-256-GCM, no plaintext leakage).
- [ ] No external JavaScript/npm build dependencies introduced.
- [ ] Tested on at least one target platform:

  - [ ] Windows (PowerShell COM / System Tray)
  - [ ] Mobile Web (iOS Safari / Android Chrome)
